material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the January breakout level, the most-traded price of six months and the average price paid since the May 20 low, where 7 levels (5 kinds) meet.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the January high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: Weekly: wave 4 in its buy zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Mar 23 to Aug 10 (+30%; wave 3 is 1.9 times wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (+0.2% to −2.3%), on lighter volume, with the 38.2% retracement of the Mar 9–Aug 10 rise in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−5.3%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.
